exercises.instruction: Посмотрите на картинки и допишите предложения. Используйте Both ... или Neither ... .
Парень и девушка одинаково ответили на вопросы. Напишите предложения, используя Both/Neither of them ... .

items.prompt: Are you a student?  Yes  Yes
Do you have a car?  No  No
answers: Neither of them has a car.
Neither of them has got a car.

items.prompt: Where do you live?  London  London
answers: Both of them live in London.

items.prompt: Do you like cooking?  Yes  Yes
Can you play the piano?  No  No
answers: Neither of them can play the piano.

items.prompt: Do you eat seafood?  Yes  Yes
Are you interested in sport?  No  No
answers: Neither of them is interested in sport.

items.prompt: У меня двое детей. Оба ходят в школу.
answers: I have two children. Both go to school.
I have two children. Both of them go to school.
I have got two children. Both go to school.
I have got two children. Both of them go to school.

items.prompt: У меня есть две сестры. Ни одна из них не живёт в России.
answers: I have two sisters. Neither of them lives in Russia.

items.prompt:
